title: Drive end states and exit codes

name.description: The state's name as a drive-status.ts --json report's state field carries it, or the name of a class of states, a withdrawn code or an exit with no report.

kind.description: state, class-label, tombstone, driver-only or helper, as the code names its categories.

exit.description: The code this entry holds in the drive's numbering.

driveStatusExit.description: The code drive-status.ts exits with when it reports this state; null when it reports no such state. A class label (NOT_SETTLED) is never itself reported: its row holds the exit its member states share. A startup refusal that names no state (UNSUPPORTED_CLI's exit 2 from drive-status.ts) is not a report, so it stays null. Not part of identity: a withdrawn code keeps its row with this null.

driveExit.description: The code drive.ts ends with for it; null when drive.ts never does.

endsDrive.description: Whether it ends the drive without the caller re-arming it on its own; null for a withdrawn code.

meaning.description: What it means to a reader that branches on it, and what that reader does next.

stop.description: For a state drive.ts ends with: the stop in one phrase, as its closing report's concluded field opens with it after the pull request's name.

cause.description: For a state drive.ts ends with short of its goal: the closing report's cause, one of the closed list of causes.

nextOwner.description: For a state drive.ts ends with: who takes the next step its closing report suggests, line, person or none.

nextAct.description: When the next step is a person's: what the person does, one of Merge, Decide, Authorize, Reply, Do or Investigate.

nextStep.description: For a state drive.ts ends with: the next step its closing report suggests.

values.name: ROUND_READY
values.meaning: Work is left for this round: open review threads or unanswered summary findings. The caller runs a pass; `drive.ts` runs it itself and never ends with this state.

values.name: INDETERMINATE
values.meaning: The state could not be read, or a step failed: `drive.ts` also ends with it when a pass fails. Never a settled state; read what the drive printed before re-arming.
values.stop: stopped on a failure; the drive's log says what failed
values.nextStep: Read what the drive's log says failed, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: UNSUPPORTED_CLI
values.meaning: A prerequisite is missing. `drive.ts` exits `2`, with no state report (a dispatcher closing report may still be written), when it refuses to start: a command line it cannot use, or a working tree or pull request it cannot drive as they stand (uncommitted changes, commits the pull request does not have, a head in a fork). It prints which. `drive-status.ts` also exits `2`, before there is a pull request to report on and naming no state, on arguments it cannot use and when its startup cannot resolve the repository or the pull request selector, which can be a network or authentication failure rather than an argument error. The same exit can end a drive already running: when a later round's `drive-status.ts` fails that way, the driver passes the `2` on, after earlier rounds' passes may have changed the tree or the pull request, so read the handoff file before assuming no work occurred.
values.stop: stopped: a usage error, or a gh that cannot report the pull request
values.nextStep: Read the drive's message, fix the command line, the working tree or the gh install it names, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: CONVERGED
values.meaning: Review work is settled: either no AI reviewer is configured, the reviewer reviewed this exact head, the draft-only skip is provisional until the PR is marked Ready and reviewed, or an earlier reviewed head has the same pull-request diff after a current-head skip notice or configured excluded-path proof. Nothing is left open. `drive.ts` exits `0` only after its own working tree is clean and its exact-head required CI proof passes; convergence alone does not make the pull request ready to merge.
values.stop: converged: review evidence covers its head and nothing is left open
values.nextStep: Merge the pull request once its required checks pass.

values.name: HEAD_LAG
values.meaning: The pull request's head on the forge and the local head disagree, and the reason says how: a local head ahead with no record of a push (push it through `guarded-push.ts`), a push the forge does not show yet (wait), a tree behind (update it), or diverged history (reconcile it). Then read again.

values.name: AWAITING_REVIEWER
values.meaning: The reviewer has not reviewed this head yet. Wait, then read again.

values.name: STALE_REVIEW
values.meaning: The reviewer's latest review describes an earlier head. Wait for its review of this one, then read again.

values.name: HEAD_MOVED
values.meaning: The head or the base moved while the round was being judged, so nothing read about it holds. Read again.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_UNKNOWN
values.meaning: The forge has not yet worked out whether the pull request merges cleanly. Read again.

values.name: NOT_SETTLED
values.meaning: The name of every state that shares exit `4`: the pull request is not ready to judge yet. Never itself a `state`; the caller waits and runs the drive again. `drive.ts` also exits `4` after the review converged when another driver holds the mark-Ready lease, when the head moved, the CI hold label changed or the forge could not be read as the hold was released, when a read of the cancelled-run recovery kept failing in a way waiting can clear, when no fresh result of a required check came in time (where a skipped or cancelled check means waiting cannot help: re-run the check, then re-arm), and when the drive keeps a draft that the reviewer skips (mark it Ready, then re-arm).
values.stop: stopped before the pull request could be judged: it has not settled yet
values.nextStep: The line drives it again once the pull request settles.

values.name: PR_NOT_OPEN
values.meaning: The pull request was merged or closed. Stop, and push nothing to it.
values.stop: ended: the pull request was merged or closed
values.nextStep: Nothing is left for the drive; a merge's follow-up settles what the merge owes.

values.name: MAX_ROUNDS
values.meaning: The drive spent its round budget (`--max-rounds`, with any rounds a re-arm granted) without converging. Read the handoff file before re-arming: a re-arm a person asks for grants one more round budget.
values.stop: used its round budget without converging
values.nextStep: Read the handoff file for what keeps the review open, then re-arm the drive, which grants it one more round budget (`jig send drive@<repo> <PR> rearm`, or `--rearm-budget` on the arm command), or take the work over.

values.name: REVIEWER_FAILED
values.meaning: The reviewer's check failed or says the review did not complete. The drive stops. The dispatcher can retry a neutral check that reports an incomplete review and escalate repeated stops on that head.
values.stop: stopped: the posting reviewer's check reported a failure
values.nextStep: Look at the reviewer's failed check, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: HITL_PARKED
values.meaning: Everything left waits on a person's decision, each framed on its thread. The drive does not wake itself: once every one is answered, re-arm it.
values.stop: parked: a decision waits for a person
values.nextStep: Answer each parked decision on its thread, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: PR_CONFLICTING
values.meaning: The pull request conflicts with its base and has nothing else to work on; `drive.ts` ends with it once its conflict-repair passes are spent. Merge the base in, then re-arm.
values.stop: stopped: it conflicts with its base and has nothing left to work
values.nextStep: Merge the base in and resolve the conflicts, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: RETIRED
values.meaning: Withdrawn: it once stopped a drive on a draft pull request, which is now driven like any other. Never exited, and never given another meaning.

values.name: SESSION_LEASE_HELD
values.meaning: Another live session in this working tree holds the drive's lease for this pull request. Nothing was changed: wait for it, or clear its lease once its process is gone.

values.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LOCK
values.meaning: Another driver already holds this pull request's or this working tree's lock, so the drive is already armed. Nothing was changed.
values.stop: refused: another driver already holds this pull request's or this working tree's lock
values.nextStep: The driver that holds the lock goes on driving.

values.name: WORKTREE_UNCLEAN
values.meaning: The working tree holds work no round shipped: uncommitted edits, an unfinished git operation or a commit nobody reviewed. Settle it, then re-arm in this tree.
values.stop: converged, but its worktree holds changes no round shipped
values.nextStep: A re-armed drive settles the working tree, then reports convergence.

values.name: DRIVE_HELD_BY_OTHER_WORKTREE
values.meaning: Another live working tree, or a driver in another clone, is driving this pull request. Nothing was changed; that driver is the one to finish.
values.stop: refused: another working tree or clone drives this pull request
values.nextStep: The driver in the other working tree or clone finishes the drive.

values.name: STALLED
values.meaning: Rounds stopped changing anything the drive can see. Read what the passes decided, and what the tree still holds, before re-arming.
values.stop: stalled: its passes changed nothing
values.nextStep: Read what the passes decided and what the working tree holds, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: PASS_DEADLINE
values.meaning: A pass ran past its deadline and was stopped more often than the drive restarts one. Check the tree for the stopped pass's leftovers before re-arming.
values.stop: stopped: its passes kept running out of time
values.nextStep: Check the working tree for the stopped pass's leftovers, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: QUOTA_PARKED
values.meaning: A pass hit an agent subscription's usage limit that does not reset soon. Re-arm after the reset, or from a session that bills another account. `drive.ts` also exits `16` when it refuses such a re-arm while the limit holds, from a session that bills the same account or one it cannot tell.
values.stop: stopped on a usage limit
values.nextStep: The line re-arms the drive after the limit resets, or on an account the limit does not hold.

values.name: PUSH_HELD
values.meaning: A `hold-push` directive in the drive's mailbox is in force, so nothing was pushed; the pre-push hook's recheck exits with it to stop a push already under way. Not an end state: clear the hold, then push again.

values.name: MAILBOX_STOPPED
values.meaning: A person or a tool told the drive to stop through its mailbox, and it stopped at a round boundary. A stop that names this driver's generation ends this driver alone; one that names none stops every later driver too, so resume it before re-arming.
values.stop: stopped: a person or a tool told it to stop through its mailbox
values.nextStep: Nothing until a person re-arms the drive.

values.name: MAILBOX_PAUSE_TIMEOUT
values.meaning: A pause sent through the drive's mailbox lasted longer than the drive waits. Resume it, then re-arm.
values.stop: stopped: a pause sent through its mailbox outlasted its wait
values.nextStep: Resume the drive through its mailbox, then re-arm it.

values.name: TAKEN_OVER
values.meaning: Another clone took the drive over and drives it now. Nothing to recover here.
values.stop: stopped: another clone took the drive over
values.nextStep: The clone that took the drive over drives it now.

values.name: CI_REPAIR_SPENT
values.meaning: The diagnosing CI-repair session could not complete the repair on the failing head. The handoff carries its diagnosis and tracker issue when available.
values.stop: stopped: the diagnosing CI-repair session could not complete the repair
values.nextStep: Read the diagnosing session’s handoff and address the blocker it recorded.

values.name: REVIEW_SKIPPED
values.meaning: The reviewer skipped or paused this head. An earlier review does not cover it, a skip notice has no stamp and Jig cannot verify that the diff is empty after the configured exclusions, or a review-object check reports `Review paused…` or `Review skipped…`. A person resumes the reviewer or has this head reviewed, then re-arms.
values.stop: stopped: the reviewer skipped its head and will not review it
values.nextStep: Resume the reviewer or have this head reviewed, then re-arm the drive.

values.name: CI_INFRA_PERSISTED
values.meaning: The review converged, but checks kept failing on the CI service's own infrastructure after the drive re-ran them. Nothing in the code needs repair; re-arm once the service recovers.
values.stop: stopped: checks kept failing on the CI service's own infrastructure
values.nextStep: The line re-arms the drive once the CI service recovers.

values.name: FORGE_RATE_LIMITED
values.meaning: The forge's rate limit for the drive's credential is spent: nothing more is sent before it resets. The report names the reset (`rateLimit.until`). The driver then waits out a reset within its bound (`DRIVE_PR_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT`) and goes on, or stops on one further off. Re-arm after the reset.
values.stop: stopped: the forge's rate limit for its credential is spent
values.nextStep: The line drives it again once the forge's rate limit resets.

values.name: CHECK_RUNS_UNREADABLE
values.meaning: The head's check-runs listing could not be read whole: a page or the whole listing ran out of time, or it has more pages than a read may take. The reason names the pages read. Nothing about the pull request was judged; run the drive again, and treat a second such stop on the same head as a systematic read failure.
values.stop: stopped: its head's check-runs listing could not be read whole
values.nextStep: The line re-drives it once for this head; a second such stop on the head is a systematic read failure for a person.
